dosing.evidence: Psilocybin (1 mg/kg) and LSD (0.08 mg/kg) or physiological saline (vehicle) were administered intraperitoneally at the volume of 1 ml/kg 30 min before the test. Animals were treated daily only in Week 1 (Days 1, 2, and 3)

D-LSD ... was prepared as tartrate salt solution (LSD, 0.1 mg/ml) ... and diluted in sterile water before injections ... administered intraperitoneally ... Animals were treated daily only in Week 1 (Days 1, 2, and 3)

group_housing.evidence: Rats were group housed (4 per cage) in the standard laboratory cages

assays.assay_description: Operant conditioning task in Med Associates chambers (56×56×40.5 cm) with two retractable levers and a food magazine delivering 45 mg sucrose pellets. Only lever presses spaced by ≥72 s were reinforced. 60-min sessions, 3-5 days per week, over 5 weeks. Measures: total lever presses, reinforced presses, peak responses, premature responses, response efficiency.

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally at the volume of 1 ml/kg 30 min before the test

setup_habituation.evidence: Rats were trained in the apparatus prior to testing, but no separate habituation protocol distinct from training is described

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats freely moved in the standard operant conditioning chambers

food_restriction.evidence: mild food restriction (~15 g per animal per day) for at least 1 week before the training ... Throughout the study, the animals were maintained at 85% of their free-feeding weight

time_to_assay.evidence: 30 min before DRL 72s session ... were then tested on the next 4 weeks (Weeks 2-5) without further injections

sample_size.evidence: Out of 36 rats, we excluded eight animals ... Animals were randomly allocated into three treatment groups

outcomes.summary: Acute psilocybin (1 mg/kg) treatment increased reinforced responses by ~46.2% and response efficiency by ~56.8% relative to vehicle in Week 1, and reduced premature responses by ~8.32%, without affecting peak press number. LSD (0.08 mg/kg) showed no significant effect. Neither drug produced persistent antidepressant-like effects in Weeks 2-5.
outcomes.statistics: multilevel mixed-effects linear regression with random intercepts for individual rats and random slopes for days; p < 0.05
outcomes.evidence: Acute treatment with psilocybin 1 mg/kg (Week 1) increased the number of reinforced responses in DRL 72s by about 46.2% as compared with vehicle control ... None of the effects persisted in the post-treatment phase on Weeks 2-5. By contrast, animals treated with LSD 0.08 mg/kg displayed behavior similar to controls, so no significant effects of LSD were found

B1_num_measures.evidence: (i) the total number of lever presses, (ii) the number of reinforced presses, (iii) the peak responses, and (iv) the premature responses. Response efficiency was defined as ...

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Analyses focused on daily/weekly totals; no within-session time-bin analysis reported

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences or transitions reported

B4_ethological.evidence: The assay measures operant lever presses, not natural ethological behaviours

B5_social.evidence: Each rat was tested alone in an operant chamber; no social component

B6_cognitive.evidence: DRL 72s is an operant food-reinforced schedule based on response inhibition and temporal discounting

B7_automated_classification.evidence: controlled via MED-PC software (lever-press detection, not behavioural classification)

B8_multivariate.evidence: Multilevel mixed-effects regression on univariate outcomes; no PCA/clustering

E1_environment_type.evidence: six standard operant conditioning chambers (Med Associates, USA), measuring 56 × 56 × 40.5 cm

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter or refuge in the operant chamber

E3_bedding.evidence: Standard operant chambers; no bedding reported

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in the testing apparatus

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in chamber during testing

E6_spatial.evidence: Each chamber had a food magazine between two retractable levers - single arena

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat performed the task alone in the chamber

E8_food_water.evidence: the animal had to withhold his response to obtain a sucrose pellet (45 mg) ... food magazine delivers sucrose pellets during the session

D1_continuity.evidence: Sessions were performed three times a week on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Wednesdays ... tested on the next 4 weeks (Weeks 2-5)

D2_session_duration.evidence: Rats were trained and tested during 60-min sessions

D3_recording_days.evidence: Sessions ... three times a week ... tested on the next 4 weeks (Weeks 2-5), plus baseline (Week 0) and dosing week (Week 1, Days 1-3) = at least 15 recording days

D4_baseline.evidence: Animals were randomly allocated into three treatment groups, based on a similar baseline number of rewards gained at the test preceding drug treatment

D5_followup.evidence: tested on the next 4 weeks (Weeks 2-5) without further injections

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single DRL 72s assay; no merging or dropping required.

Food restriction scored as 'before' rather than 'during': animals were chronically food-restricted to 85% free-feeding weight prior to and throughout the study, and sucrose pellets were the reinforcer delivered during the session (accessible during recording), so 'before' best captures the deliberate pre-test restriction.
E8 food/water scored 1 (yes): sucrose pellets are delivered and accessible during the operant session.
D3 scored 15+ days: baseline week + 3 dosing days + 3 sessions/week × 4 follow-up weeks ≈ 15+ recording days for this assay.
time_to_assay set to 'multiple' since the same DRL assay was run acutely (30 min post-dose) and at 1-4 week follow-ups.
LSD vehicle set to 'water' per Methods ('diluted in sterile water before injections').
n_per_group_min left null because the paper does not give per-group n after exclusions (28 rats / 3 groups, unbalanced).
